source_selection: Prefer MAP for even owner seed and REWARDS for odd. Among available preferred-family (act,floor,family) strata choose minimum SHA256([46001,owner,stratum]); within that stratum choose minimum SHA256([46002,owner,step]). Fall back to the other family only if preferred family has no root. Legal single-action roots included. No terminal outcome or return enters selection.
small_selection: 48 natural and 48 assisted owners; within each distribution group roots by (act,family,floor); deterministic round-robin sorted strata, owners ordered SHA256([46003,owner]). Freeze before reading return labels.

training.root_weighting: equal root weight, inverse legal count per option
training.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation root-weighted MSE, then epoch, then initialization seed
training.initialization: uniform(-0.05,0.05) weights, zero biases; tiny uses unchanged Issue43 Scorer initialization; bigger uses Python Random same seeds
